title: Python: TS, a local with one binding to type(self) or self.__class__ is treated as cls (DEC-303 (a22) item 3, (a23))
description: DEC-303 (a22) item 3 admitted group TS: a local with exactly ONE binding, a plain unannotated assignment of type(self) or self.__class__ where self is the method's receiver parameter (rule 26) and type is the unshadowed builtin, is treated as cls: k.meth() looks meth up on the enclosing class's MRO as cls.meth() does, with the same polymorphic flag. Every binding of the local must be enumerable (item 2: enumerableBindings, no nonlocal or global rewrite, no del); a second binding, a rebound self, an annotation, a shadowed type, a write to self.__class__ in the class ((a25) item 3, later) refuses. No new rule: the (a22)/(a23) admission and the cls-receiver rule 26. Built per the other admitted groups: fixtures red before and green after with callee pinned and the full bin delta, positive twins, per-binding-kind refused fixtures, mutants by name observed red, and the five-pin corpus diff with every in-repo edge created or removed reported to opum-doc before the clear. Reference site: tqdm/std.py:91 cls = type(self), then cls.th_lock and cls.create_mp_lock().

acceptanceCriteria.text: k = type(self) and k = self.__class__ in a method make k.meth() resolve to the enclosing class method as cls.meth() does, each fixture red before and green after with the callee symbol pinned and the full bin delta

every binding kind that makes the local not single (rebind, del, for, with, walrus, nonlocal or global write, annotation, parameter) and a shadowed type or self refuse, with a refused fixture each asserting no edge and the bin unchanged, and positive twins
five-pin corpus diff script-asserted with each moved site named; any in-repo edge created or removed comes to opum-doc before the clear
mutation checks by name, each observed red

plan: Add a classOf fact to the call and attr right-hand sides (read only by localClassOfReceiver); one arm in resolveAttributeCall after R4: a local with ONE binding (item 2 enumeration), plain unannotated type(x) or x.__class__, x the receiver of an instance method (rule 26), type unshadowed; lookup via methodLookup as self.m() and cls.m() (DEC-303 (a22) item 3, (a23)).
implementationNotes: Built in opum-ai/glyph-cli#194, landed 2026-11-26 as squash cfdcdeac (final head 5def4cdd). Rounds: (a55) item 3 added fixtures for __class__ defined by the enclosing class or an in-repo MRO base (source change: x.__class__ form refuses); (a56) item 2 failed closed on an MRO entry whose scope cannot be read (opaque, or external and not an unshadowed builtin class); Opus round 1 (B1): handleAssignment had recorded k = type(x) as a new rhs kind, removing pre-PR edges for an in-repo class named type, fixed by an extra optional classOf field with six fixtures that are red on the regression and green on dev; (a57); Opus round 2 test-only (a58): guards for the callee and attribute shapes, the MRO-failure reason, the nested type shadow. Classmethod type(cls) refuses (metaclass), ruled in (a55) item 2.

Corpus: five pins (flask 49943b5a, httpx 7cff5f79, jinja 5ef70112, rich 3a109ccd, tqdm 9cf5a12b) against origin/dev 051e4dc: exactly ONE in-repo edge created, tqdm/std.py:95:9 cls.create_mp_lock() -> std.py:115:9, accepted in DEC-303 (a55) item 1; none removed; bins, polymorphicCount and multiplyBound otherwise unchanged. The diff was measured by a throwaway script run on a git archive of dev and on the branch; the script is not committed.

Mutants observed red: single-binding count, type shadow, instance kind, annotation, receiver identity, enumeration, polymorphic flag, type-versus-attribute form, argument count, __class__ check disabled, applied to type(self), enclosing-only, opaque entry ignored, every opaque refused, callee guard, attribute guard, MRO failure scan, type shadow read scope. Equivalent: the function-scope guard. Follow-ups filed: GCLI-120 (a57 items 2 and 3), GCLI-122 (a58 items 2 to 4, descendant __class__).
finalSummary: TS landed (opum-ai/glyph-cli#194, cfdcdeac): a local with one binding to type(self) or self.__class__ in an instance method is treated as cls, resolving k.meth() on the enclosing class's MRO with the same polymorphic flag. Verified by 65 fixtures in test/python-ts.test.ts (each positive red before, refused ones with per-binding-kind controls, no-edge and exact bin delta), 18 mutants observed red, two Opus review rounds, full suite and four CI checks green on the landed head, and the five-pin corpus diff: one accepted created edge (tqdm std.py:95 to std.py:115), none removed.
